options.label: 영상·음성 형식 선택식
options.help: Video format code, see "FORMAT SELECTION" for more details

options.label: 형식 정렬 기준
options.help: Sort the formats by the fields given, see "Sorting Formats" for more details

options.label: 파일명 템플릿
options.help: Output filename template; see "OUTPUT TEMPLATE" for details

options.label: 저장 경로
options.help: The paths where the files should be downloaded. Specify the type of file and the path separated by a colon ":". All the same TYPES as --output are supported. Additionally, you can also provide "home" (default) and "temp" paths. All intermediary files are first downloaded to the temp path and then the final files are moved over to the home path after download is finished. This option is ignored if --output is an absolute path

options.label: 오디오 추출
options.help: Convert video files to audio-only files (requires ffmpeg and ffprobe)

options.label: 오디오 형식
options.help: Format to convert the audio to when -x is used. (currently supported: best (default), aac, alac, flac, m4a, mp3, opus, vorbis, wav). You can specify multiple rules using similar syntax as --remux-video

options.label: 오디오 품질
options.help: Specify ffmpeg audio quality to use when converting the audio with -x. Insert a value between 0 (best) and 10 (worst) for VBR or a specific bitrate like 128K (default 5)

options.label: 자막 저장
options.help: Write subtitle file

options.label: 자동 자막 저장
options.help: Write automatically generated subtitle file (Alias: --write-automatic-subs)

options.label: 자막 언어
options.help: Languages of the subtitles to download (can be regex) or "all" separated by commas, e.g. --sub-langs "en.*,ja" (where "en.*" is a regex pattern that matches "en" followed by 0 or more of any character). You can prefix the language code with a "-" to exclude it from the requested languages, e.g. --sub-langs all,-live_chat. Use --list-subs for a list of available language tags

options.label: 자막 내장
options.help: Embed subtitles in the video (only for mp4, webm and mkv videos)

options.label: 표지 내장
options.help: Embed thumbnail in the video as cover art

options.label: 메타데이터 내장
options.help: Embed metadata to the video file. Also embeds chapters/infojson if present unless --no-embed-chapters/--no-embed-info-json are used (Alias: --add-metadata)

options.label: 쿠키 파일
options.help: Netscape formatted file to read cookies from and dump cookie jar in

options.label: 브라우저 쿠키 사용
options.help: The name of the browser to load cookies from. Currently supported browsers are: brave, chrome, chromium, edge, firefox, opera, safari, vivaldi, whale. Optionally, the KEYRING used for decrypting Chromium cookies on Linux, the name/path of the PROFILE to load cookies from, and the CONTAINER name (if Firefox) ("none" for no container) can be given with their respective separators. By default, all containers of the most recently accessed profile are used. Currently supported keyrings are: basictext, gnomekeyring, kwallet, kwallet5, kwallet6

options.label: 사용자 이름
options.help: Login with this account ID

options.label: 비밀번호
options.help: Account password. If this option is left out, yt-dlp will ask interactively

options.label: 프록시
options.help: Use the specified HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS proxy. To enable SOCKS proxy, specify a proper scheme, e.g. socks5://user:pass@127.0.0.1:1080/. Pass in an empty string (--proxy "") for direct connection

options.label: 시간·챕터 구간
options.help: Download only chapters that match the regular expression. A "*" prefix denotes time-range instead of chapter. Negative timestamps are calculated from the end. "*from-url" can be used to download between the "start_time" and "end_time" extracted from the URL. Needs ffmpeg. This option can be used multiple times to download multiple sections, e.g. --download-sections "*10:15-inf" --download-sections "intro"

options.label: 재생목록 항목
options.help: Comma-separated playlist_index of the items to download. You can specify a range using "[START]:[STOP][:STEP]". For backward compatibility, START-STOP is also supported. Use negative indices to count from the right and negative STEP to download in reverse order. E.g. "-I 1:3,7,-5::2" used on a playlist of size 15 will download the items at index 1,2,3,7,11,13,15

options.label: 중복 다운로드 기록
options.help: Download only videos not listed in the archive file. Record the IDs of all downloaded videos in it

options.label: 동시 조각 수
options.help: Number of fragments of a dash/hlsnative video that should be downloaded concurrently (default is 1)

options.label: 다운로드 속도 제한
options.help: Maximum download rate in bytes per second, e.g. 50K or 4.2M

options.label: 재시도 횟수
options.help: Number of retries (default is 10), or "infinite"

options.label: 컨테이너 변경
options.help: Remux the video into another container if necessary (currently supported: avi, flv, gif, mkv, mov, mp4, webm, aac, aiff, alac, flac, m4a, mka, mp3, ogg, opus, vorbis, wav). If the target container does not support the video/audio codec, remuxing will fail. You can specify multiple rules; e.g. "aac>m4a/mov>mp4/mkv" will remux aac to m4a, mov to mp4 and anything else to mkv

options.label: 영상 재인코딩
options.help: Re-encode the video into another format if necessary. The syntax and supported formats are the same as --remux-video

options.label: 챕터별 파일 분리
options.help: Split video into multiple files based on internal chapters. The "chapter:" prefix can be used with "--paths" and "--output" to set the output filename for the split files. See "OUTPUT TEMPLATE" for details

options.label: SponsorBlock 구간 제거
options.help: SponsorBlock categories to be removed from the video file, separated by commas. If a category is present in both mark and remove, remove takes precedence. The syntax and available categories are the same as for --sponsorblock-mark except that "default" refers to "all,-filler" and poi_highlight, chapter are not available

options.label: 사이트별 추출 인수
options.help: Pass ARGS arguments to the IE_KEY extractor. See "EXTRACTOR ARGUMENTS" for details. You can use this option multiple times to give arguments for different extractors

options.label: 외부 명령 실행
options.help: Execute a command, optionally prefixed with when to execute it, separated by a ":". Supported values of "WHEN" are the same as that of --use-postprocessor (default: after_move). The same syntax as the output template can be used to pass any field as arguments to the command; however, for security reasons the only allowed conversions are: "i"/"d" (signed integer decimal), "f" (floating-point decimal) and "q" (shell-quoted). If no fields are passed, %(filepath,_filename|)q is appended to the end of the command. This option can be used multiple times

options.label: 플러그인 폴더
options.help: Path to an additional directory to search for plugins. This option can be used multiple times to add multiple directories. Use "default" to search the default plugin directories (default)

options.label: 설정 파일 불러오기
options.help: Location of the main configuration file; either the path to the config or its containing directory ("-" for stdin). Can be used multiple times and inside other configuration files

options.label: 정보 출력 템플릿
options.help: Field name or output template to print to screen, optionally prefixed with when to print it, separated by a ":". Supported values of "WHEN" are the same as that of --use-postprocessor (default: video). Implies --quiet. Implies --simulate unless --no-simulate or later stages of WHEN are used. This option can be used multiple times

options.label: 메타데이터 JSON 조회
options.help: Quiet, but print JSON information for each URL or infojson passed. Simulate unless --no-simulate is used. If the URL refers to a playlist, the whole playlist information is dumped in a single line

options.label: 다운로드 없이 확인
options.help: Do not download the video and do not write anything to disk

options.label: 미디어 다운로드 생략
options.help: Do not download the video but write all related files (Alias: --no-download)

options.label: 엔진 버전 변경
options.help: Upgrade/downgrade to a specific version. CHANNEL can be a repository as well. CHANNEL and TAG default to "stable" and "latest" respectively if omitted; See "UPDATE" for details. Supported channels: stable, nightly, master

options.label: 형식 목록 조회
options.help: List available formats of each video. Simulate unless --no-simulate is used

options.label: 자막 목록 조회
options.help: List available subtitles of each video. Simulate unless --no-simulate is used

options.label: 라이브 처음부터
options.help: Download livestreams from the start. Currently experimental and only supported for YouTube, Twitch, TVer, and mellow-fan

options.label: 방송 시작 대기
options.help: Wait for scheduled streams to become available. Pass the minimum number of seconds (or range) to wait between retries

options.label: FFmpeg 위치
options.help: Location of the ffmpeg binary; either the path to the binary or its containing directory

options.label: JavaScript 실행 환경
options.help: Additional JavaScript runtime to enable, with an optional location for the runtime (either the path to the binary or its containing directory). This option can be used multiple times to enable multiple runtimes. Supported runtimes are (in order of priority, from highest to lowest): deno, node, quickjs, bun. Only "deno" is enabled by default. The highest priority runtime that is both enabled and available will be used. In order to use a lower priority runtime when "deno" is available, --no-js-runtimes needs to be passed before enabling other runtimes

options.label: 다운로드 조건식
options.help: Generic video filter. Any "OUTPUT TEMPLATE" field can be compared with a number or a string using the operators defined in "Filtering Formats". You can also simply specify a field to match if the field is present, use "!field" to check if the field is not present, and "&" to check multiple conditions. Use a "\" to escape "&" or quotes if needed. If used multiple times, the filter matches if at least one of the conditions is met. E.g. --match-filters !is_live --match-filters "like_count>?100 & description~='(?i)\bcats \& dogs\b'" matches only videos that are not live OR those that have a like count more than 100 (or the like field is not available) and also has a description that contains the phrase "cats & dogs" (caseless). Use "--match-filters -" to interactively ask whether to download each video

options.label: 이 날짜 이후
options.help: Download only videos uploaded on or after this date. The date formats accepted are the same as --date

options.label: 이 날짜 이전
options.help: Download only videos uploaded on or before this date. The date formats accepted are the same as --date

options.label: help
options.help: Print this help text and exit

options.label: version
options.help: Print program version and exit

options.label: update
options.help: Check if updates are available. You installed yt-dlp from a manual build or with a package manager; Use that to update

options.label: no update
options.help: Do not check for updates (default)

options.label: ignore errors
options.help: Ignore download and postprocessing errors. The download will be considered successful even if the postprocessing fails

options.label: no abort on error
options.help: Continue with next video on download errors; e.g. to skip unavailable videos in a playlist (default)

options.label: abort on error
options.help: Abort downloading of further videos if an error occurs (Alias: --no-ignore-errors)

options.label: list extractors
options.help: List all supported extractors and exit

options.label: extractor descriptions
options.help: Output descriptions of all supported extractors and exit

options.label: use extractors
options.help: Extractor names to use separated by commas. You can also use regexes, "all", "default" and "end" (end URL matching); e.g. --ies "holodex.*,end,youtube". Prefix the name with a "-" to exclude it, e.g. --ies default,-generic. Use --list-extractors for a list of extractor names. (Alias: --ies)

options.label: default search
options.help: Use this prefix for unqualified URLs. E.g. "gvsearch2:python" downloads two videos from google videos for the search term "python". Use the value "auto" to let yt-dlp guess ("auto_warning" to emit a warning when guessing). "error" just throws an error. The default value "fixup_error" repairs broken URLs, but emits an error if this is not possible instead of searching

options.label: ignore config
options.help: Don't load any more configuration files except those given to --config-locations. For backward compatibility, if this option is found inside the system configuration file, the user configuration is not loaded. (Alias: --no-config)

options.label: no config locations
options.help: Do not load any custom configuration files (default). When given inside a configuration file, ignore all previous --config-locations defined in the current file

options.label: no plugin dirs
options.help: Clear plugin directories to search, including defaults and those provided by previous --plugin-dirs

options.label: no js runtimes
options.help: Clear JavaScript runtimes to enable, including defaults and those provided by previous --js-runtimes

options.label: remote components
options.help: Remote components to allow yt-dlp to fetch when required. This option is currently not needed if you are using an official executable or have the requisite version of the yt-dlp-ejs package installed. You can use this option multiple times to allow multiple components. Supported values: ejs:npm (external JavaScript components from npm), ejs:github (external JavaScript components from yt-dlp-ejs GitHub). By default, no remote components are allowed

options.label: no remote components
options.help: Disallow fetching of all remote components, including any previously allowed by --remote-components or defaults.

options.label: flat playlist
options.help: Do not extract a playlist's URL result entries; some entry metadata may be missing and downloading may be bypassed

options.label: no flat playlist
options.help: Fully extract the videos of a playlist (default)

options.label: no live from start
options.help: Download livestreams from the current time (default)

options.label: no wait for video
options.help: Do not wait for scheduled streams (default)

options.label: mark watched
options.help: Mark videos watched (even with --simulate)

options.label: no mark watched
options.help: Do not mark videos watched (default)

options.label: color
options.help: Whether to emit color codes in output, optionally prefixed by the STREAM (stdout or stderr) to apply the setting to. Can be one of "always", "auto" (default), "never", or "no_color" (use non color terminal sequences). Use "auto-tty" or "no_color-tty" to decide based on terminal support only. Can be used multiple times

options.label: compat options
options.help: Options that can help keep compatibility with youtube-dl or youtube-dlc configurations by reverting some of the changes made in yt-dlp. See "Differences in default behavior" for details

options.label: alias
options.help: Create aliases for an option string. Unless an alias starts with a dash "-", it is prefixed with "--". Arguments are parsed according to the Python string formatting mini-language. E.g. --alias get-audio,-X "-S aext:{0},abr -x --audio-format {0}" creates options "--get-audio" and "-X" that takes an argument (ARG0) and expands to "-S aext:ARG0,abr -x --audio-format ARG0". All defined aliases are listed in the --help output. Alias options can trigger more aliases; so be careful to avoid defining recursive options. As a safety measure, each alias may be triggered a maximum of 100 times. This option can be used multiple times

options.label: preset alias
options.help: Applies a predefined set of options. e.g. --preset-alias mp3. The following presets are available: mp3, aac, mp4, mkv, sleep. See the "Preset Aliases" section at the end for more info. This option can be used multiple times

options.label: socket timeout
options.help: Time to wait before giving up, in seconds

options.label: source address
options.help: Client-side IP address to bind to

options.label: impersonate
options.help: Client to impersonate for requests. E.g. chrome, chrome-110, chrome:windows-10. Pass --impersonate="" to impersonate any client. Note that forcing impersonation for all requests may have a detrimental impact on download speed and stability

options.label: list impersonate targets
options.help: List available clients to impersonate.

options.label: force ipv4
options.help: Make all connections via IPv4

options.label: force ipv6
options.help: Make all connections via IPv6

options.label: enable file urls
options.help: Enable file:// URLs. This is disabled by default for security reasons.

options.label: geo verification proxy
options.help: Use this proxy to verify the IP address for some geo-restricted sites. The default proxy specified by --proxy (or none, if the option is not present) is used for the actual downloading

options.label: xff
options.help: How to fake X-Forwarded-For HTTP header to try bypassing geographic restriction. One of "default" (only when known to be useful), "never", an IP block in CIDR notation, or a two-letter ISO 3166-2 country code

options.label: min filesize
options.help: Abort download if filesize is smaller than SIZE, e.g. 50k or 44.6M

options.label: max filesize
options.help: Abort download if filesize is larger than SIZE, e.g. 50k or 44.6M

options.label: date
options.help: Download only videos uploaded on this date. The date can be "YYYYMMDD" or in the format [now|today|yesterday][-N[day|week|month|year]]. E.g. "--date today-2weeks" downloads only videos uploaded on the same day two weeks ago

options.label: no match filters
options.help: Do not use any --match-filters (default)

options.label: break match filters
options.help: Same as "--match-filters" but stops the download process when a video is rejected

options.label: no break match filters
options.help: Do not use any --break-match-filters (default)

options.label: no playlist
options.help: Download only the video, if the URL refers to a video and a playlist

options.label: yes playlist
options.help: Download the playlist, if the URL refers to a video and a playlist

options.label: age limit
options.help: Download only videos suitable for the given age

options.label: no download archive
options.help: Do not use archive file (default)

options.label: max downloads
options.help: Abort after downloading NUMBER files

options.label: break on existing
options.help: Stop the download process when encountering a file that is in the archive supplied with the --download-archive option

options.label: no break on existing
options.help: Do not stop the download process when encountering a file that is in the archive (default)

options.label: break per input
options.help: Alters --max-downloads, --break-on-existing, --break-match-filters, and autonumber to reset per input URL

options.label: no break per input
options.help: --break-on-existing and similar options terminates the entire download queue

options.label: skip playlist after errors
options.help: Number of allowed failures until the rest of the playlist is skipped

options.label: throttled rate
options.help: Minimum download rate in bytes per second below which throttling is assumed and the video data is re-extracted, e.g. 100K

options.label: file access retries
options.help: Number of times to retry on file access error (default is 3), or "infinite"

options.label: fragment retries
options.help: Number of retries for a fragment (default is 10), or "infinite" (DASH, hlsnative and ISM)

options.label: retry sleep
options.help: Time to sleep between retries in seconds (optionally) prefixed by the type of retry (http (default), fragment, file_access, extractor) to apply the sleep to. EXPR can be a number, linear=START[:END[:STEP=1]] or exp=START[:END[:BASE=2]]. This option can be used multiple times to set the sleep for the different retry types, e.g. --retry-sleep linear=1::2 --retry-sleep fragment:exp=1:20

options.label: skip unavailable fragments
options.help: Skip unavailable fragments for DASH, hlsnative and ISM downloads (default) (Alias: --no-abort-on-unavailable-fragments)

options.label: abort on unavailable fragments
options.help: Abort download if a fragment is unavailable (Alias: --no-skip-unavailable-fragments)

options.label: keep fragments
options.help: Keep downloaded fragments on disk after downloading is finished

options.label: no keep fragments
options.help: Delete downloaded fragments after downloading is finished (default)

options.label: buffer size
options.help: Size of download buffer, e.g. 1024 or 16K (default is 1024)

options.label: resize buffer
options.help: The buffer size is automatically resized from an initial value of --buffer-size (default)

options.label: no resize buffer
options.help: Do not automatically adjust the buffer size

options.label: http chunk size
options.help: Size of a chunk for chunk-based HTTP downloading, e.g. 10485760 or 10M (default is disabled). May be useful for bypassing bandwidth throttling imposed by a webserver (experimental)

options.label: playlist random
options.help: Download playlist videos in random order

options.label: lazy playlist
options.help: Process entries in the playlist as they are received. This disables n_entries, --playlist-random and --playlist-reverse

options.label: no lazy playlist
options.help: Process videos in the playlist only after the entire playlist is parsed (default)

options.label: hls use mpegts
options.help: Use the mpegts container for HLS videos; allowing some players to play the video while downloading, and reducing the chance of file corruption if download is interrupted. This is enabled by default for live streams

options.label: no hls use mpegts
options.help: Do not use the mpegts container for HLS videos. This is default when not downloading live streams

options.label: downloader
options.help: Name or path of the external downloader to use (optionally) prefixed by the protocols (http, ftp, m3u8, dash, rtmp) to use it for. Currently supports native, aria2c, axel, curl, ffmpeg, httpie, wget. You can use this option multiple times to set different downloaders for different protocols. E.g. --downloader aria2c --downloader "dash,m3u8:native" will use aria2c for http/ftp downloads, and the native downloader for dash/m3u8 downloads (Alias: --external-downloader)

options.label: downloader args
options.help: Give these arguments to the external downloader. Specify the downloader name and the arguments separated by a colon ":". For ffmpeg, arguments can be passed to different positions using the same syntax as --postprocessor-args. You can use this option multiple times to give different arguments to different downloaders (Alias: --external-downloader-args)

options.label: batch file
options.help: File containing URLs to download ("-" for stdin), one URL per line. Lines starting with "#", ";" or "]" are considered as comments and ignored

options.label: no batch file
options.help: Do not read URLs from batch file (default)

options.label: output na placeholder
options.help: Placeholder for unavailable fields in --output (default: "NA")

options.label: restrict filenames
options.help: Restrict filenames to only ASCII characters, and avoid "&" and spaces in filenames

options.label: no restrict filenames
options.help: Allow Unicode characters, "&" and spaces in filenames (default)

options.label: windows filenames
options.help: Force filenames to be Windows-compatible

options.label: no windows filenames
options.help: Sanitize filenames only minimally

options.label: trim filenames
options.help: Limit the filename length (excluding extension) to the specified number of characters

options.label: no overwrites
options.help: Do not overwrite any files

options.label: force overwrites
options.help: Overwrite all video and metadata files. This option includes --no-continue

options.label: no force overwrites
options.help: Do not overwrite the video, but overwrite related files (default)

options.label: continue
options.help: Resume partially downloaded files/fragments (default)

options.label: no continue
options.help: Do not resume partially downloaded fragments. If the file is not fragmented, restart download of the entire file

options.label: part
options.help: Use .part files instead of writing directly into output file (default)

options.label: no part
options.help: Do not use .part files - write directly into output file

options.label: mtime
options.help: Use the Last-modified header to set the file modification time

options.label: no mtime
options.help: Do not use the Last-modified header to set the file modification time (default)

options.label: write description
options.help: Write video description to a .description file

options.label: no write description
options.help: Do not write video description (default)

options.label: write info json
options.help: Write video metadata to a .info.json file (this may contain personal information)

options.label: no write info json
options.help: Do not write video metadata (default)

options.label: write playlist metafiles
options.help: Write playlist metadata in addition to the video metadata when using --write-info-json, --write-description etc. (default)

options.label: no write playlist metafiles
options.help: Do not write playlist metadata when using --write-info-json, --write-description etc.

options.label: clean info json
options.help: Remove some internal metadata such as filenames from the infojson (default)

options.label: no clean info json
options.help: Write all fields to the infojson

options.label: write comments
options.help: Retrieve video comments to be placed in the infojson. The comments are fetched even without this option if the extraction is known to be quick (Alias: --get-comments)

options.label: no write comments
options.help: Do not retrieve video comments unless the extraction is known to be quick (Alias: --no-get-comments)

options.label: load info json
options.help: JSON file containing the video information (created with the "--write-info-json" option)

options.label: no cookies
options.help: Do not read/dump cookies from/to file (default)

options.label: no cookies from browser
options.help: Do not load cookies from browser (default)

options.label: cache dir
options.help: Location in the filesystem where yt-dlp can store some downloaded information (such as client ids and signatures) permanently. By default ${XDG_CACHE_HOME}/yt-dlp

options.label: no cache dir
options.help: Disable filesystem caching

options.label: rm cache dir
options.help: Delete all filesystem cache files

options.label: write thumbnail
options.help: Write thumbnail image to disk

options.label: no write thumbnail
options.help: Do not write thumbnail image to disk (default)

options.label: write all thumbnails
options.help: Write all thumbnail image formats to disk

options.label: list thumbnails
options.help: List available thumbnails of each video. Simulate unless --no-simulate is used

options.label: write link
options.help: Write an internet shortcut file, depending on the current platform (.url, .webloc or .desktop). The URL may be cached by the OS

options.label: write url link
options.help: Write a .url Windows internet shortcut. The OS caches the URL based on the file path

options.label: write webloc link
options.help: Write a .webloc macOS internet shortcut

options.label: write desktop link
options.help: Write a .desktop Linux internet shortcut

options.label: quiet
options.help: Activate quiet mode. If used with --verbose, print the log to stderr

options.label: no quiet
options.help: Deactivate quiet mode. (Default)

options.label: no warnings
options.help: Ignore warnings

options.label: no simulate
options.help: Download the video even if printing/listing options are used

options.label: ignore no formats error
options.help: Ignore "No video formats" error. Useful for extracting metadata even if the videos are not actually available for download (experimental)

options.label: no ignore no formats error
options.help: Throw error when no downloadable video formats are found (default)

options.label: print to file
options.help: Append given template to the file. The values of WHEN and TEMPLATE are the same as that of --print. FILE uses the same syntax as the output template. This option can be used multiple times

options.label: dump json
options.help: Quiet, but print JSON information for each video. Simulate unless --no-simulate is used. See "OUTPUT TEMPLATE" for a description of available keys

options.label: force write archive
options.help: Force download archive entries to be written as far as no errors occur, even if -s or another simulation option is used (Alias: --force-download-archive)

options.label: newline
options.help: Output progress bar as new lines

options.label: no progress
options.help: Do not print progress bar

options.label: progress
options.help: Show progress bar, even if in quiet mode

options.label: console title
options.help: Display progress in console titlebar

options.label: progress template
options.help: Template for progress outputs, optionally prefixed with one of "download:" (default), "download-title:" (the console title), "postprocess:",  or "postprocess-title:". The video's fields are accessible under the "info" key and the progress attributes are accessible under "progress" key. E.g. --console-title --progress-template "download-title:%(info.id)s-%(progress.eta)s"

options.label: progress delta
options.help: Time between progress output (default: 0)

options.label: verbose
options.help: Print various debugging information

options.label: dump pages
options.help: Print downloaded pages encoded using base64 to debug problems (very verbose)

options.label: write pages
options.help: Write downloaded intermediary pages to files in the current directory to debug problems

options.label: print traffic
options.help: Display sent and read HTTP traffic

options.label: encoding
options.help: Force the specified encoding (experimental)

options.label: legacy server connect
options.help: Explicitly allow HTTPS connection to servers that do not support RFC 5746 secure renegotiation

options.label: no check certificates
options.help: Suppress HTTPS certificate validation

options.label: prefer insecure
options.help: Use an unencrypted connection to retrieve information about the video

options.label: add headers
options.help: Specify a custom HTTP header and its value, separated by a colon ":". You can use this option multiple times

options.label: bidi workaround
options.help: Work around terminals that lack bidirectional text support. Requires bidiv or fribidi executable in PATH

options.label: sleep requests
options.help: Number of seconds to sleep between requests during data extraction

options.label: sleep interval
options.help: Number of seconds to sleep before each download. This is the minimum time to sleep when used along with --max-sleep-interval (Alias: --min-sleep-interval)

options.label: max sleep interval
options.help: Maximum number of seconds to sleep. Can only be used along with --min-sleep-interval

options.label: sleep subtitles
options.help: Number of seconds to sleep before each subtitle download

options.label: format sort reset
options.help: Disregard previous user specified sort order and reset to the default

options.label: format sort force
options.help: Force user specified sort order to have precedence over all fields, see "Sorting Formats" for more details (Alias: --S-force)

options.label: no format sort force
options.help: Some fields have precedence over the user specified sort order (default)

options.label: video multistreams
options.help: Allow multiple video streams to be merged into a single file

options.label: no video multistreams
options.help: Only one video stream is downloaded for each output file (default)

options.label: audio multistreams
options.help: Allow multiple audio streams to be merged into a single file

options.label: no audio multistreams
options.help: Only one audio stream is downloaded for each output file (default)

options.label: prefer free formats
options.help: Prefer video formats with free containers over non-free ones of the same quality. Use with "-S ext" to strictly prefer free containers irrespective of quality

options.label: no prefer free formats
options.help: Don't give any special preference to free containers (default)

options.label: check formats
options.help: Make sure formats are selected only from those that are actually downloadable

options.label: check all formats
options.help: Check all formats for whether they are actually downloadable

options.label: no check formats
options.help: Do not check that the formats are actually downloadable

options.label: merge output format
options.help: Containers that may be used when merging formats, separated by "/", e.g. "mp4/mkv". Ignored if no merge is required. (currently supported: avi, flv, mkv, mov, mp4, webm)

options.label: no write subs
options.help: Do not write subtitle file (default)

options.label: no write auto subs
options.help: Do not write auto-generated subtitles (default) (Alias: --no-write-automatic-subs)

options.label: sub format
options.help: Subtitle format; accepts formats preference separated by "/", e.g. "srt" or "ass/srt/best"

options.label: twofactor
options.help: Two-factor authentication code

options.label: netrc
options.help: Use .netrc authentication data

options.label: netrc location
options.help: Location of .netrc authentication data; either the path or its containing directory. Defaults to ~/.netrc

options.label: netrc cmd
options.help: Command to execute to get the credentials for an extractor.

options.label: video password
options.help: Video-specific password

options.label: ap mso
options.help: Adobe Pass multiple-system operator (TV provider) identifier, use --ap-list-mso for a list of available MSOs

options.label: ap username
options.help: Multiple-system operator account login

options.label: ap password
options.help: Multiple-system operator account password. If this option is left out, yt-dlp will ask interactively

options.label: ap list mso
options.help: List all supported multiple-system operators

options.label: client certificate
options.help: Path to client certificate file in PEM format. May include the private key

options.label: client certificate key
options.help: Path to private key file for client certificate

options.label: client certificate password
options.help: Password for client certificate private key, if encrypted. If not provided, and the key is encrypted, yt-dlp will ask interactively

options.label: postprocessor args
options.help: Give these arguments to the postprocessors. Specify the postprocessor/executable name and the arguments separated by a colon ":" to give the argument to the specified postprocessor/executable. Supported PP are: Merger, ModifyChapters, SplitChapters, ExtractAudio, VideoRemuxer, VideoConvertor, Metadata, EmbedSubtitle, EmbedThumbnail, SubtitlesConvertor, ThumbnailsConvertor, FixupStretched, FixupM4a, FixupM3u8, FixupTimestamp and FixupDuration. The supported executables are: AtomicParsley, FFmpeg and FFprobe. You can also specify "PP+EXE:ARGS" to give the arguments to the specified executable only when being used by the specified postprocessor. Additionally, for ffmpeg/ffprobe, "_i"/"_o" can be appended to the prefix optionally followed by a number to pass the argument before the specified input/output file, e.g. --ppa "Merger+ffmpeg_i1:-v quiet". You can use this option multiple times to give different arguments to different postprocessors. (Alias: --ppa)

options.label: keep video
options.help: Keep the intermediate video file on disk after post-processing

options.label: no keep video
options.help: Delete the intermediate video file after post-processing (default)

options.label: post overwrites
options.help: Overwrite post-processed files (default)

options.label: no post overwrites
options.help: Do not overwrite post-processed files

options.label: no embed subs
options.help: Do not embed subtitles (default)

options.label: no embed thumbnail
options.help: Do not embed thumbnail (default)

options.label: no embed metadata
options.help: Do not add metadata to file (default) (Alias: --no-add-metadata)

options.label: embed chapters
options.help: Add chapter markers to the video file (Alias: --add-chapters)

options.label: no embed chapters
options.help: Do not add chapter markers (default) (Alias: --no-add-chapters)

options.label: embed info json
options.help: Embed the infojson as an attachment to mkv/mka video files

options.label: no embed info json
options.help: Do not embed the infojson as an attachment to the video file

options.label: parse metadata
options.help: Parse additional metadata like title/artist from other fields; see "MODIFYING METADATA" for details. Supported values of "WHEN" are the same as that of --use-postprocessor (default: pre_process)

options.label: replace in metadata
options.help: Replace text in a metadata field using the given regex. This option can be used multiple times. Supported values of "WHEN" are the same as that of --use-postprocessor (default: pre_process)

options.label: xattrs
options.help: Write metadata to the video file's xattrs (using Dublin Core and XDG standards)

options.label: concat playlist
options.help: Concatenate videos in a playlist. One of "never", "always", or "multi_video" (default; only when the videos form a single show). All the video files must have the same codecs and number of streams to be concatenable. The "pl_video:" prefix can be used with "--paths" and "--output" to set the output filename for the concatenated files. See "OUTPUT TEMPLATE" for details

options.label: fixup
options.help: Automatically correct known faults of the file. One of never (do nothing), warn (only emit a warning), detect_or_warn (the default; fix the file if we can, warn otherwise), force (try fixing even if the file already exists)

options.label: no exec
options.help: Remove any previously defined --exec

options.label: convert subs
options.help: Convert the subtitles to another format (currently supported: ass, lrc, srt, vtt). Use "--convert-subs none" to disable conversion (default) (Alias: --convert-subtitles)

options.label: convert thumbnails
options.help: Convert the thumbnails to another format (currently supported: jpg, png, webp). You can specify multiple rules using similar syntax as "--remux-video". Use "--convert-thumbnails none" to disable conversion (default)

options.label: no split chapters
options.help: Do not split video based on chapters (default)

options.label: remove chapters
options.help: Remove chapters whose title matches the given regular expression. The syntax is the same as --download-sections. This option can be used multiple times

options.label: no remove chapters
options.help: Do not remove any chapters from the file (default)

options.label: force keyframes at cuts
options.help: Force keyframes at cuts when downloading/splitting/removing sections. This is slow due to needing a re-encode, but the resulting video may have fewer artifacts around the cuts

options.label: no force keyframes at cuts
options.help: Do not force keyframes around the chapters when cutting/splitting (default)

options.label: use postprocessor
options.help: The (case-sensitive) name of plugin postprocessors to be enabled, and (optionally) arguments to be passed to it, separated by a colon ":". ARGS are a semicolon ";" delimited list of NAME=VALUE. The "when" argument determines when the postprocessor is invoked. It can be one of "pre_process" (after video extraction), "after_filter" (after video passes filter), "video" (after --format; before --print/--output), "before_dl" (before each video download), "post_process" (after each video download; default), "after_move" (after moving the video file to its final location), "after_video" (after downloading and processing all formats of a video), or "playlist" (at end of playlist). This option can be used multiple times to add different postprocessors

options.label: sponsorblock mark
options.help: SponsorBlock categories to create chapters for, separated by commas. Available categories are sponsor, intro, outro, selfpromo, preview, filler, interaction, music_offtopic, hook, poi_highlight, chapter, all and default (=all). You can prefix the category with a "-" to exclude it. See [1] for descriptions of the categories. E.g. --sponsorblock-mark all,-preview [1] https://wiki.sponsor.ajay.app/w/Segment_Categories

options.label: sponsorblock chapter title
options.help: An output template for the title of the SponsorBlock chapters created by --sponsorblock-mark. The only available fields are start_time, end_time, category, categories, name, category_names. Defaults to "[SponsorBlock]: %(category_names)l"

options.label: no sponsorblock
options.help: Disable both --sponsorblock-mark and --sponsorblock-remove

options.label: sponsorblock api
options.help: SponsorBlock API location, defaults to https://sponsor.ajay.app

options.label: extractor retries
options.help: Number of retries for known extractor errors (default is 3), or "infinite"

options.label: allow dynamic mpd
options.help: Process dynamic DASH manifests (default) (Alias: --no-ignore-dynamic-mpd)

options.label: ignore dynamic mpd
options.help: Do not process dynamic DASH manifests (Alias: --no-allow-dynamic-mpd)

options.help: Split HLS playlists to different formats at discontinuities such as ad breaks

options.label: no hls split discontinuity
options.help: Do not split HLS playlists into different formats at discontinuities such as ad breaks (default)
